title: Air-gap Private Deploy: Operator Runbook (sketch)
body:
Purpose:
This is a personal sketch/runbook for performing an initial air-gapped (offline) installation of the Redwood Private control-plane + inference runtime for a customer datacenter. Intended for on-call / field engineers who will be shipping the initial images, cert bundles, and operator credentials into a locked environment.

Scope / assumptions:
- Customer environment has no outbound internet.
- We are providing an install artifact bundle to be transported via removable media (USB or signed ISO).
- Customer manages physical access; operator team (Redwood) provides signed artifacts and operator runbook.
- This runbook covers: packaging, signing, preflight, install steps, post-install verifications, and basic troubleshooting.
- Not covering: Kubernetes upgrades, day-2 autoscaling tuning, SOC hardening checklist (separate doc).

High-level flow:
1) Build & freeze artifacts in secure build env (CI gated).
   - Build: control-plane images, runtime images, init containers, CRDs, operator helm charts.
   - Capture SBOM + provenance for each image (sha256).
2) Sign artifacts & bundle: image manifest, release binary tarball, helm charts, keys/cert templates, install scripts.
3) Transfer to airgap media: generate signed ISO + copy to encrypted USB (FIPS-safe).
4) On-site preflight by customer: run checksum + signature verification.
5) On-site operator: run install script (offline mode) using provided bundle.
6) Post-install verification and telemetry sink configuration (outbound optional via customer proxy).

Packaging checklist (operator):
- release-manifest.yaml (list of artifacts + sha256)
- sbom/ (cyclonedx.json per image)
- charts/ (helm v3 tarballs)
- images/ (OCI tarballs saved with "docker save" or "skopeo copy" layout)
- keys/ (public agent certs, operator verification cert only; private keys never on media)
- docs/ (this runbook, minimal install README, offline troubleshooting)
- signature.bundle (signed with our release key - gpg/PKCS7)

Signature verification (customer preflight):
- Verify release-manifest.yaml signature using our public verification cert (provide fingerprint beforehand via secure channel).
- Recompute sha256 on each image/chart and compare to manifest.
- Confirm SBOM manifests exist and match images.

Config shape sketch (minimal values required) - YAML-like text sample:

# redwood-offline-config.yaml
apiVersion: redwood/v1
kind: OfflineInstallConfig
metadata:
  tenant: acme-corp
  region: us-west-2-dc3
spec:
  mode: airgap
  runtime:
    imagesPath: ./images/
    defaultNodePool: gpu-pool-1
  controlPlane:
    certificates: ./keys/control-plane-pub.pem
    adminBootstrapToken: "REDACTED-TOKEN-TO-OVERRIDE"
  telemetry:
    mode: none # or remote-proxy
    allowedProxies: []
  k8s:
    requiredVersion: ">=1.26 <1.28"
  kmsIntegration: "customer-managed" # placeholder

Notes on config:
- adminBootstrapToken is single-use; recommend customer rotates immediately after first login.
- When telemetry.mode=none, operator will skip attempting to reach Redwoods cloud.

Install script (operator steps, offline):
- Step 0: Ensure host has tools: tar, gpg, containerd/crictl, kubectl, helm
- Step 1: Unpack signed bundle; run ./verify-bundle.sh (verifies manifest + sig)
- Step 2: Load images into local registry (scripts support podman/docker/containerd load)
- Step 3: Apply CRDs and helm charts (helm install --dependency-update --wait --timeout 10m)
- Step 4: Run bootstrap job to create admin secret (prints one-time url+token)
- Step 5: Validate pods are Ready and perform smoke tests (see smoke test checklist below)

Smoke test checklist (post-install):
- control-plane api server responds to cluster status endpoint (/status) locally
- agent can pull model manifest from local registry and initialize (simulate inference with small prompt)
- key rotation endpoint accepts new public key and returns 200 OK
- helm-release versions match release-manifest entries

Troubleshooting quick notes:
- If images fail to load: check OCI tar manifest, ensure toolchain used (docker vs podman) supported; compare sha256 of extracted layers to manifest.
- CRDs stuck in Unknown: check CRD apiVersion compatibility (k8s version mismatch is common in air-gap installs).
- Operator failing with TLS handshake: confirm customer's CA bundle includes our agent CA; mismatch often caused by missing SANs on certs.
- If bootstrap token expired during manual steps: run local reset with provided reset-tool (requires signed operator approval).

Telemetry & minimal observability offline:
- Default is to run with telemetry disabled. For customers who allow outbound via corporate proxy, support:
  - TLS-terminated proxy with mutual auth (provide client certs in bundle).
  - push-only model: runtime batches internal metrics to a filesystem sink; operator can scp these to a secured hop for ingestion.
- Add a local fluent-forwarder chart in the bundle (optional) to aggregate logs to a customer endpoint.

Operator safety & cryptography notes:
- Private signing keys must never be included in the media. Signing performed in a HSM-protected CI runner.
- Provide both PGP and RFC-compliant CMS signatures for customer compatibility.
- Include key fingerprint via independent channel (e.g., email + Slack for enterprise contacts) before handoff.

Open questions / TODOs (my notes):
- Decide canonical offline image format (OCI layout tar vs docker save) — need to standardize our save/load tooling across distros. (TODO: RDW-6321 assigned)
- How to rotate fleet-wide keys post-install without risking outage? draft a safe rollback path.
- Minimal hardware profile doc to include with bundle (GPU counts, disk sizes).
- Should we include an automated "repackage with customer repo" script that consumes customer internal registry creds? legal/security implications.
- Add a smoke-test harness that can run entirely in k8s Job and produce an artifacts.tar.gz for us to ingest later.

References & links (for field use):
- internal confluence: CONFLUENCE-PRIVATEDEPLOY-72 (artifact registry + signing)
- jira: RDW-6321 (airgap packaging standardization)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy/pull/128 (initial offline loader scripts)

Quick timeline estimate for a field install (rough):
- Build & sign: 1 engineer full day (assuming clean CI)
- Transfer to media + courier: 1-3 business days depending on customer contracts
- On-site preflight + install: 2-4 hours for experienced operator; up to 1 day with customer validation and CA work

Notes-to-self / next steps: 
- Convert this sketch -> readme in charts/ directory and include minimal check scripts.
- Pair with Priya to finalize signature formats and add sbom linking in manifest (not just files).
- Bake a "verify-bundle.sh --ci-output" mode that prints machine-parsable status.

End of scratchpad runbook. Keep lightweight and pragmatic; share with field engs for feedback before promoting to shared_drives/docs.
